US Heatwave and Storms Disrupt July 4th Celebrations

A significant heatwave and severe storms impacted the United States around its July 4th Independence Day celebrations. The extreme weather led to the cancellation of events, including parades and fairs, and caused evacuations in some areas. Power grids were also strained by the high temperatures.
